decisions.reason: The organization-chart action does not alter the table requirement. The independent table-incorporation decision from the same message is already represented, and budget-sheet inclusion is not contradicted.
Changing the organization chart from creation to incorporation does not change the requirement to include supplied narrative content.
The revised organization-chart action does not modify or cancel the existing RFQ page-count target.
Photo incorporation is an independent requirement already established by message 47 and is unchanged by the organization-chart action.
The organization-chart action does not further change the full-document layout requirement, whose message-47 revisions are already represented.
The organization-chart integration change has no necessary effect on the independently specified GreenLatinos branding state at this time.
The change from creating to incorporating the organization chart does not alter the print-ready PDF deliverable.
